description: OKX perpetual-swap liquidations for one underlying (e.g. BTC-USD): the most recent 100 filled forced liquidations, split into long and short liquidated USD value, with the largest events. Covers OKX only, and the window is the latest 100 events, not a fixed 24h total. Other exchanges' liquidation streams are not reported. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coinlore when you need CoinLore ranked crypto list: USD price, market cap, 24h; crypto_coinmarketcap when you need CoinMarketCap ranked crypto listing: name, symbol, USD. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_crypto_liquidations_feed
